name: Pilot Hammerfoot
summary: Near the mountain passes, Pilot Hammerfoot watches over the Siege Brigade’s engines and worries for a missing fellow pilot. He seeks travelers to search the hills, where the high ridges put dwarves in danger.

sections.title: Eyes in the Mountains
sections.body: At North Gate Outpost, Pilot Hammerfoot watches the passes between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan and guards the Siege Brigade’s engines. Ironforge’s siege engines are prized by the brigade, but rough mountain ground makes them dangerous to drive. When a pilot goes missing, finding him matters, especially with savage beasts roaming the nearby hills.

sections.title: Avenging a Comrade
sections.body: Pilot Hammerfoot was close friends with Pilot Mori Hildelve, another siege engine pilot. The two searched for rare ore when Hildelve broke his engine on a steep hill and continued on foot alone. Hammerfoot learned that Mangeclaw, a huge ice claw bear, mauled Hildelve to death. Now Hammerfoot seeks retribution against the beast that killed his friend.

faq.answer: Pilot Hammerfoot serves Ironforge as a dwarven siege engine pilot. He watches the border from North Gate Outpost, along the pass between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan, and keeps watch over the region and the other pilots.

faq.q: Where can Pilot Hammerfoot be found?
faq.answer: Pilot Hammerfoot can be found at North Gate Outpost, beside the mountain highway and tunnel pass between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan.

faq.q: What happened to Hammerfoot's partner, Pilot Hildelve?
faq.answer: Pilot Mori Hildelve broke his siege engine on a steep hill while searching for rare ore, then continued on foot. Hammerfoot has heard nothing from him and asks travelers to search for him.

faq.q: Why is Hammerfoot worried about his partner?
faq.answer: Hammerfoot and Mori Hildelve are close friends and fellow Siege Brigade pilots. Hildelve went missing in dangerous mountain country, and Hammerfoot needs someone to find out what happened.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you share the fierce camaraderie of Ironforge’s mountaineers and refuse to let a fallen brother’s murder go unanswered.
When you aid Hammerfoot, you help secure vital reconnaissance outposts along the main highway between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan.
